# Atropos at Home
> Premium smart home automation, distributed audio, and home theatre — Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

## About
Atropos at Home is a Tasmanian business delivering end-to-end smart home automation, distributed audio, premium home theatre design, home networking, and acoustic treatment. We work with architects, builders, and discerning homeowners across Tasmania. Parent company: Atropos Industries Pty Ltd, Hobart, TAS 7000.

## Services
- Smart Home Automation: Whole-home integration of lighting, climate, security, blinds, and entertainment using RTI, Control4, and Crestron. New builds and retrofits.
- Premium Home Theatre: Bespoke design, acoustic treatment, Dolby Atmos installation, 4K laser projection, and professional calibration.
- Distributed Audio / Full-home Sound: Multi-room audio with Bluesound, Sonance, KEF, and Bowers & Wilkins. Outdoor audio included.
- Network & Connectivity: Enterprise-grade whole-home Wi-Fi and structured cabling using Ubiquiti UniFi, Ruckus, and Cisco Meraki.
- Acoustic Treatment: Purpose-built broadband absorbers, diffusers, and bass traps for home theatres and listening rooms.
- Ongoing Support & Maintenance: Remote monitoring, update management, and priority on-site support.

## Service Area
Primary: Hobart, Tasmania. Also: Launceston, and broader Tasmania.
